name: fresh-review
description: Pre-commit fresh-eyes code review. Runs the lattice review, the gstack security audit, and a background cross-model Codex pass against one shared diff packet via context-isolated subagents, then triages the findings back in the producer context and logs the run. Deliberately skips gstack's /review — /ship runs that on the final diff — and ships a dispatch gate that trims the parts of ship's own review army this run already covered.
